text.title: JTBD Switch Interview Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether the interviewee actually completed a switch and how recently, whether a fired alternative can be named, and whether the struggling moment attaches to a datable event — to a full backwards-timeline interview, a corrective probe, or a skip to a different interview form.

decision-tree.root-question: Did the person on the call complete a real purchase or switch, and how long ago was it?

branch.when: prospect, trial user who never paid, or someone still deciding — no purchase event exists

conclusion.verdict: skip; there is no switch to reconstruct. Route to a problem interview or continuous-discovery touchpoint instead

branch.when: a purchase happened but more than 90 days ago

conclusion.verdict: do not run this interview; recall of the timeline degrades past 90 days. Recruit a fresher switcher rather than accepting reconstructed memory

branch.when: a real purchase or switch completed within the last 90 days, 60 preferred
branch.question: Can the interviewee name what was displaced — a prior product, a workaround, a person, or an explicit "nothing, we tolerated it"?

branch.when: the interviewee describes adopting the new thing but nothing was displaced and no explicit "nothing" is stated

conclusion.verdict: keep probing for the fired alternative before scoring anything; an artefact with a blank fired-alternative fails validation

branch.when: a fired alternative is named, including an explicit "nothing — the problem was tolerated"
branch.question: Does the First Thought attach to a datable event — a lost client, a price rise, a failed audit, a new hire, a device that died — or only to a standing condition?

branch.when: the trigger surfaces only as a standing condition: "we were growing", "it was getting messy"

conclusion.verdict: keep walking the timeline backwards until a datable event surfaces; a standing condition is not a struggling moment and must not be recorded as one

branch.when: a specific datable event anchors both First Thought and Active Looking

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; walk backwards from purchase through the six transitions, ask what happened and never why, quote all four forces verbatim and state the switch arithmetic
